page.overview:
Who is Claes Glinka?

Claes Glinka, the self-proclaimed "Guardian of Morality", is a zealous adherent of the Moral Crusade in the Empire of Man. He's a fanatical lay preacher who does not serve a specific god but instead seeks to embody conventional Imperial morality as a whole. Glinka's ideology is one of extreme puritanism -- denouncing pleasure, licentiousness, and indulgence in all forms as the "Road to Chaos and damnation."
